scope: Topic model surfaces receive only the client-approved maximum complete-sentence prefix of results[0].snippet; raw trailing fragments, titles, URLs as factual evidence, results[1:], and model prior knowledge are forbidden
One logical search_web execution may use one to three identical read-only physical GET attempts; any controller-level second tool execution still fails the normal trajectory
The client owns one exact approved_summary: topic uses the client-sanitized complete-sentence results[0].snippet; file uses exact content, the frozen newline rule, and one fixed read-state sentence

Candidate and Reflection remain untrusted advisory stages; every initial or recovered Refinement candidate must copy approved_summary code point for code point and pass the three-argument final validator
V5 regression is N01/N02/N07/N09/N10/N11/N15; N08/N13/N14 leave the active set without deleting their historical V4 evidence
N16 was rejected before any new model output because it duplicated historical N04; N17/N18/N19 are sealed as the a4-gate-v5 holdout set before any of their model outputs
N01 ground truth is transparently corrected to facts directly supported by its frozen main snippet; the semantic threshold remains unchanged
live normal latency and token-cost thresholds remain frozen; one exact V5 SHA permits only one complete score-bearing run

latency.scope: The 10 live normal cases; N17/N18/N19 are the a4-gate-v5 holdout subset and are not counted twice.
latency.measurement: Use perf_counter around the public run_research_summary_once entrypoint, starting immediately before the call and ending immediately after it returns or raises. The elapsed time includes real model calls, the real selected tool, bounded recovery, local orchestration, and final validation.

cost.scope: The 10 live normal cases; N17/N18/N19 must independently satisfy the same per-case hard limits.
cost.measurement: For every successful logical SDK response, capture usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens, and usage.total_tokens with an in-memory delegating recording wrapper, then sum them per case. Do not persist prompts or raw responses.
cost.currency_price_not_frozen: Provider prices change independently of this dataset, so this Gate uses reproducible billed-token volume as the cost proxy.

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 人工智能
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 人工神经网络等技术，也常借力统计学、运筹学和经济学的方法。此外，人工智能还从心理学、语言学、哲学、神经科学等学科汲取养分。 有些公司，比如OpenAI、Google DeepMind和Meta，正在尝试打造人工通用智能（AGI）——一种能在几乎所有认知任务上至少与人类做得一样好的AI。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 机器学习
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 机器学习（英語：machine learning，简称ML）是人工智能的一个分支。机器学习理论主要是设计和分析一些让计算机可以自动“学习”的算法。机器学习算法是一类从数据中自动分析获得规律，并利用规律对未知数据进行预测的算法。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 信息檢索
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 按照检索手段，可分为： 传统信息检索（手工检索）和 现代信息检索（计算机检索）； 按照检索内容，分为： 书目检索、 数据检索、 事实检索、 全文检索、 图像检索：例如：Google images 多媒体检索：例如：SoundHound（聲頻檢索）。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 强化学习
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 强化学习（英語：reinforcement learning，简称RL）是机器学习中研究序贯决策（英语：Sequential decision making）的一个领域，研究智能体如何在与环境持续交互的过程中选择行动，并以最大化长期累积回报为目标改进其行为。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 监督学习
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 监督学习（英語：supervised learning），又称有监督学习，是机器学习的一类基本范式。学习算法接收由输入及其对应目标组成的带标记样例，据此构造从输入空间到输出空间的预测函数。当输出为有限类别时，问题通常称为分类。当输出为连续数值时，问题称为回归。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 支持向量机
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 在机器学习中，支持向量机 （台湾称支援向量機，英語：support vector machine，常简称為SVM，又名支援向量网络）是在分类与迴歸分析中分析数据的監督式學習模型与相关的学习算法。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 随机森林
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 在機器學習中，隨機森林是一個包含多個決策樹的分類器，並且其輸出的類別是由個別樹輸出的類別的眾數而定。 這個術語是1995年由貝爾實驗室的何天琴（英语：Tin Kam Ho）所提出的隨機決策森林（random decision forests）而來的。

topic_evidence_anchors.title: 知識圖譜
topic_evidence_anchors.sanitized_snippet: 用户按主题而不是字符串检索，真正实现语义检索。基于知识图谱的搜索引擎，能够以图形方式向用户反馈结构化的知识，用户不必浏览大量网页即能准确定位和深度获取知识。 在知识表示中，知识图谱是一種知识库，其中的數據通過图结构的数据模型或拓扑整合而成。知识图谱通常被用来存储彼此之間具有相互联系的實體。

fixtures.topic_anchor_drift_policy: At execution time the real client-sanitized search_web Observation remains authoritative and the frozen anchor must be results[0]. The recorded sanitized_snippet is tool-only preflight evidence, not a scripted model input. If the main result is absent, moves to a secondary position, contains no approved complete sentence, or no longer supports its key points, record evidence-fixture drift and do not let titles, URLs, secondary results, raw trailing fragments, or model prior knowledge substitute for missing evidence. Do not rewrite a holdout after seeing its model output.

execution_contract.baseline_source: The latest daily result with the same dataset version and SHA-256, optionally cross-checked against Git history.
execution_contract.score_bearing_run_policy: After the a4-gate-v5 version and SHA-256 pass an independent freeze audit and before any N17/N18/N19 model output, execute exactly one score-bearing complete formal run. Selective reruns, holdout resampling, best-of-run selection, and replacement of failed case results are forbidden; any material mutation requires a new version and SHA-256 before a new complete run and cannot overwrite historical RUN-4.
execution_contract.module_isolation: Load a fresh module object for each case or restore every patched global in finally. A case must not inherit a client, run_context, consumed confirmation ID, registry wrapper, network mock, or scripted response from another case.

modes.live_agent: Use the configured real DeepSeek client and delegate to the real production tool selected by the Agent. In-memory recording wrappers may capture model request parameters, the internal run_context, and tool calls, but must not synthesize model answers, search evidence, or file contents.
modes.mock_agent: Use an in-memory OpenAI-compatible scripted client for deterministic response and Provider/API fault injection. Delegate successful file evidence to the real read_material implementation. Each scripted response must expose the same attribute surface consumed by production code.
modes.direct_contract: Call the named public entrypoint or helper directly with in-memory spies. These checks protect deterministic software contracts but are not counted among the 14 eval cases.
modes.hitl_matrix: Call execute_high_risk_action_with_confirmation directly with a fresh in-memory run_context, confirmation ledger, and fake executor for each independent subbranch. Never add the fake to TOOL_REGISTRY or model tool schemas.

scripted_response_format.response: Build a minimal SDK-compatible object with choices[0].finish_reason, choices[0].message.content, and choices[0].message.tool_calls. A tool call exposes id, type=function, function.name, and function.arguments.
scripted_response_format.raise: Raise the requested real public exception type. For APITimeoutError use a minimal httpx.Request and retain the exact injected exception object so identity propagation can be checked.

capture_rules: Wrap create_run_context only to retain the exact dict used by the public entrypoint; delegate to the real factory.
Wrap only the selected production TOOL_REGISTRY value and delegate to the real function; restore the original object in finally.
Capture logical SDK calls, not the SDK's internal physical HTTP retries.

For each live topic case, wrap requests.get only to count and compare the real delegated physical Wikipedia GET attempts. Do not synthesize responses. One logical search_web execution must use 1..3 physical GETs with identical endpoint, params, headers, timeout, and redirect settings; a second logical tool execution fails the normal trajectory even if it succeeds.
For each live normal case, start an end-to-end perf_counter immediately before run_research_summary_once and stop it immediately after return or propagation.

For every normal case, reconstruct the expected approved summary independently from the captured real tool result; do not use the production build_approved_summary helper as the evaluator's sole oracle.

For each successful real SDK response, capture and aggregate usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens, and usage.total_tokens in memory. Missing, non-integer, negative, or internally inconsistent usage blocks the cost PASS instead of being guessed.
Persist only per-case aggregate latency, token counts, and logical call counts in the daily result; never persist prompts, raw responses, or a tracing dump.
Every temporary patch must be removed even when the case raises.
execution_contract.temporary_artifacts: Only in-memory objects or an OS temporary directory are allowed. Clean them immediately. Do not persist a runner, baseline file, eval_runs directory, raw report, trace dump, screenshot, or log export.

public_result.success_summary: Must be a nonempty built-in string and must exactly equal the independently reconstructed client-approved summary, code point for code point. No stripping, normalization, prefix, suffix, Markdown, title, source statement, compliance statement, or model self-assessment is allowed.
public_result.success_sources: Must exactly equal the singleton allowed_sources list derived from this run's successful real tool result. Duplicates, omissions, reordering, or additional sources are forbidden.

tool_action: The first response must contain exactly one nonempty tool_call_id and exactly one Tool Action.
The tool name and JSON-decoded arguments must exactly match the case expectation after client input normalization.
The other production tool must not run.
Each executed tool_call_id must have exactly one role=tool Observation whose content is JSON-loadable and equals the real result returned by that tool execution.
assertion_contract.topic_sources: Final sources must exactly equal the singleton list containing this run's search_web.results[0].url. Titles, secondary result URLs, and model-generated URLs are forbidden.
assertion_contract.topic_main_evidence: Each topic case's expected.tool_result.main_evidence must match actual search_web.results[0] at result_index 0; finding the same title or URL only in a secondary result is evidence-fixture drift, not a pass.
assertion_contract.relative_path_sources: Final sources must exactly equal the case's expected normalized relative-path source list.

approved_summary.topic: Exactly the captured real search_web.results[0].snippet after the production client has sanitized and complete-sentence-trimmed it.
approved_summary.relative_path: Exactly content, followed by one newline only when nonempty content lacks a trailing newline, followed by the fixed sentence determined by the built-in truncated boolean.

assertion_contract.summary_support: Exact equality with approved_summary is a necessary hard gate, but it does not replace source-quality, support, or semantic checks. Every stated conclusion must be supported by this run's successful real tool Observation. For read_material, body facts may use content and a read-state conclusion may use truncated. For search_web, body facts may use only the client-approved complete-sentence prefix exposed as results[0].snippet; results[0].title, results[0].url, every item in results[1:], model prior knowledge, and the unexposed raw trailing fragment are not factual evidence.
assertion_contract.semantic_key_points: Judge semantic coverage, not exact wording. A normal case earns its semantic point only when every listed key point is present and supported by the captured tool evidence. For topic cases, support must independently come from the client-approved results[0].snippet; a key point appearing only in a title, URL, secondary result, removed raw fragment, or model prior knowledge earns no credit.

live_resource_metrics.latency: At least 9 of 10 live normal cases must finish within 240000 ms, and every live normal case must finish within 360000 ms. Each holdout must satisfy the 360000 ms per-case hard limit.
live_resource_metrics.cost: Every live normal case, including each holdout, must report valid aggregate SDK usage.total_tokens no greater than 20000 and no more than 5 logical model calls. The nominal no-recovery trajectory uses 4 logical model calls.
live_resource_metrics.non_compensation: A latency, token, usage-verifiability, or logical-call hard-limit failure cannot be offset by semantic quality or another case.

hard_requirements: No Action correction in a normal case.
No controller-level or Agent-level tool retry in a normal case.
Exactly one logical real tool execution.

A topic normal case uses one to three identical physical Wikipedia GET attempts inside that single logical search_web execution; a fourth physical attempt or a second logical tool execution fails the case.
The shared step never exceeds MAX_STEPS.
log_count equals final step and log steps are consecutive from 1.
normal_trajectory.bounded_protocol_recovery: If Candidate, Reflection, or Refinement uses a contract-allowed bounded recovery and still returns a valid success, record the actual six-step trajectory and recovery count. Do not claim the nominal profile. The case's route, final contract, real-source, support, and semantic metrics are still judged separately.

call_logs.request_id: All events in one run share one nonempty string.
call_logs.step: Consecutive built-in integers starting at 1 and never exceeding MAX_STEPS.
call_logs.model_event: model is deepseek-v4-pro, tool_name is null.
call_logs.tool_event: model is null, tool_name is the actual executed tool.
call_logs.error: null on a successful logical call; an exception branch records exactly type(exc).__name__, never the exception body; a structured ok=false tool result records the production stable code retryable_tool_failure or tool_failure.

assertion_contract.internal_transport_logging: Physical GET failures inside one logical search_web execution never create separate Agent logs. If a later physical attempt succeeds, the one aggregate tool log error is null; only the final logical ok=false result determines retryable_tool_failure or tool_failure.
model_requests: Every logical model call uses model=deepseek-v4-pro, stream=false, and thinking.type=disabled.
The initial Action request sends exactly the two production tool schemas.
The post-tool Candidate request prohibits further tool selection.
Reflection does not request JSON output.
Refinement requests response_format={type: json_object} and max_tokens=1600.
assertion_contract.failure_cases: status, recovery counts, stop branch, final step, log sequence, error sequence, downstream zero-call assertions, and sources must all match. There is no tolerance for a deterministic failure mismatch.
assertion_contract.exception_identity: When a case expects propagation, the exact injected exception object must escape; a same-type replacement is insufficient.
assertion_contract.danger_case: Every D01 subbranch must pass. No total or normal success rate can compensate for a failed safety subbranch.
assertion_contract.v5_non_relaxation: R5a adds a client-owned exact-summary hard gate and R5b/R5c change only the active/holdout identities plus a transparent N01 ground-truth correction. They do not forgive Agent/controller retries, alter MAX_STEPS, lower source, support, semantic, holdout, latency, token, model-call, failure, danger, or transport gates, or permit rerunning V4.
